about_the_game:
Three monsters. Three games. One night.

A lot that what kids say, is dismissed as child imagination. But what if only lose the ability so see what they see. And more what if this things are coming for you a no one else would believe you? 

The monsters from down your bed or the closet are maybe more real than you think and they come for you to take part of your imagination or eat it all if you don’t play along.

No help, no way to hide, just you and your teddy.

What do you need to do to survive?

You are at home, trying to make it through the night. During the night, you will wake up several times. Listen carefully to your plushy helpers, because they will tell you what comes next.

As the night goes on, three monsters will visit you one after another. Each brings its own twisted game, like hide and seek. You must play and win if you want to survive. If you lose, you die.

So, what’s the game?

Teddy Won’t Help is a psychological, atmospheric horror experience where you step into the small shoes of a child trying to defeat the monsters crawling out from under the bed. You play from a first-person perspective, waking up again and again, never sure if what you’re experiencing is real or just a never-ending nightmare you’ve fallen into.

content_descriptors.notes: There are horror and jump scare elements, and the mood is quite dark. It also includes dead people, mild violence, and scary monsters.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11, Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • OS: Windows 11, Windows 10

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 8GB

short_description: One night, your plushies whisper a warning: Three monsters from under the bed will come for you before dawn. The only way to survive is to play their games… and win. Fail, and you won’t live to see the morning.
